notes: Pre-approval concept "Status trail" for #361. An html surface loads one static file for every case, so the single case stacks all 14 required states as labelled sections inside one main element; each capture covers every state in one theme and viewport. States: On Today; Canvas entry; Check open; Answer not accepted; Back after a refresh; Couldn’t submit; Saved, being scored; Today while it’s scored; Scoring didn’t finish; Result can’t be confirmed; Check can’t count; Passed; Not yet; No check ready. Synthetic copy only, with no learner data, answer keys or rubrics. Review annotations above each frame are not product UI. Fill separation compares the open-check card with the page.
